name: Analysis jobs for EC2 Key Pairs

statements.query: MATCH (:CloudanixWorkspace{id: $WORKSPACE_ID})-[:OWNER]->(:AWSOrganization{id: $ORGANIZATION_ID})-[:OWNER]->(:AWSAccount{id: $AWS_ID})-[:RESOURCE]->(k:EC2KeyPair) WHERE k.user_uploaded IS NOT NULL REMOVE k.user_uploaded return COUNT(*) as TotalCompleted

MATCH (:CloudanixWorkspace{id: $WORKSPACE_ID})-[:OWNER]->(:AWSOrganization{id: $ORGANIZATION_ID})-[:OWNER]->(:AWSAccount{id: $AWS_ID})-[:RESOURCE]->(k:EC2KeyPair) WHERE k.duplicate_keyfingerprint IS NOT NULL REMOVE k.duplicate_keyfingerprint return COUNT(*) as TotalCompleted

MATCH (:CloudanixWorkspace{id: $WORKSPACE_ID})-[:OWNER]->(:AWSOrganization{id: $ORGANIZATION_ID})-[:OWNER]->(:AWSAccount{id: $AWS_ID})-[:RESOURCE]->(k1:EC2KeyPair)-[r:MATCHING_FINGERPRINT]->(k2:EC2KeyPair) WHERE r.lastupdated <> $UPDATE_TAG DELETE (r) return COUNT(*) as TotalCompleted

statements.__comment__: Set EC2KeyPairs with MD5 hash keyfingerprints (47 characters, instead of 59 characters) as user_uploaded = True
statements.query: MATCH (:CloudanixWorkspace{id: $WORKSPACE_ID})-[:OWNER]->(:AWSOrganization{id: $ORGANIZATION_ID})-[:OWNER]->(:AWSAccount{id: $AWS_ID})-[:RESOURCE]->(k:EC2KeyPair) WHERE size(k.keyfingerprint) = 47 SET k.user_uploaded = True return COUNT(*) as TotalCompleted

statements.__comment__: Attach this account's EC2KeyPairs to keys of the same workspace with the same fingerprint (one key reused across the customer's accounts) and flag this account's key. The other key is flagged by its own account's run, so the reset above clears exactly what this sets.
statements.query: MATCH (w:CloudanixWorkspace{id: $WORKSPACE_ID})-[:OWNER]->(:AWSOrganization{id: $ORGANIZATION_ID})-[:OWNER]->(:AWSAccount{id: $AWS_ID})-[:RESOURCE]->(k1:EC2KeyPair) MATCH (w)-[:OWNER]->(:AWSOrganization)-[:OWNER]->(:AWSAccount)-[:RESOURCE]->(k2:EC2KeyPair) WHERE k1.id <> k2.id AND k1.keyfingerprint = k2.keyfingerprint SET k1.duplicate_keyfingerprint = True MERGE (k1)-[r:MATCHING_FINGERPRINT]-(k2) ON CREATE SET r.firstseen = $UPDATE_TAG SET r.lastupdated = $UPDATE_TAG return COUNT(*) as TotalCompleted
